channel.title: Violations Watch: grave violations against children
channel.description: New incidents tagged with one of the six grave violations against children (UN Security Council resolution 1612). Open-source leads, not UN-verified cases.

item.title: Saudi-led coalition airstrikes across five Yemeni provinces on 18 Nov: Houthi-run health ministry reports 11 civilians killed and 36 wounded, including three killed at a guesthouse in Mocha; a kidney dialysis centre in al-Hawban, Taiz, reported damaged
item.description: Unverified lead (High priority). Yemen. Types: Killing of civilians, Air / drone / artillery strike, Attacks on healthcare & aid. Alleged perpetrator: Saudi-led coalition. Reported casualties: 11 killed, 36 injured. Grave violations against children: Attacks on schools and hospitals. Disputed or caveats: Figures from the Houthi-run health ministry in Sanaa and party-affiliated media (Fars, Saba); the coalition says it hit "60 legitimate military targets". 2 sources.
